reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Trade Me has a public developer API including Used Motors search and listing detail; dealers/VMS integrators use a Motors REST API (motorsapi@trademe.co.nz).

fields.name: consumer_key
fields.help: Trade Me API consumer key of your registered application (My Trade Me → Developer options; API access is granted after Trade Me reviews the application).

fields.name: consumer_secret
fields.help: The application's consumer secret: sent as the OAuth 1.0a PLAINTEXT signature '<consumer secret>&' over HTTPS (Trade Me's documented PLAINTEXT workflow).

adapter.terms: Trade Me API terms (https://developer.trademe.co.nz/api-terms): applications are reviewed before keys work; calls are rate-limited. Prices in NZD, odometer in km.

search_listings.note: GET /v1/Search/Motors/Used.json ('filtered keyword search in the Used cars section of Trade Me Motors') with the application-level OAuth 1.0a PLAINTEXT header; rows ≤ 25 without a member token. make is a Trade Me Used-cars subcategory name (e.g. Toyota), model a model name; condition New|Used; location is not a search filter here (user_region takes a numeric motors region id, not mapped). price is StartPrice (NZD; for classifieds the asking price, see raw.PriceDisplay and raw.BuyNowPrice); StartDate uses Trade Me's '/Date(ms)/' format. Listing page: https://www.trademe.co.nz/a/<ListingId>.

get_listing.note: GET /v1/Listings/<ListingId>.json (ListedItemDetail): title, StartPrice/BuyNowPrice/PriceDisplay, Region, Body, Attributes (make, model, year, odometer … as name/value pairs) and Photos stay in raw.

not_offered.decode_vin: No VIN lookup in the Trade Me API reference (MotorWeb reports are seller-purchased extras on a listing).
not_offered.get_valuation: No valuation method in the Trade Me API reference.
not_offered.list_dealers: No dealer directory method for motors in the Trade Me API reference.
not_offered.me: Member endpoints (/v1/MyTradeMe/Summary) need a member access token from the OAuth 1.0a flow; this adapter signs as the application only.

live_check.notes: requires consumer_key, consumer_secret; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
